variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: val is for final (immutable), var is for mutable variables.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
val int i = 1
val double f = 2.0
val boolean b = true
val String s = 'Text'
data_types.notes: Uses Java types, with type inference.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
val a = 5 + 3
val b = a * 2
val c = (a == b) && true
operators.notes: Standard Java operators, plus operator overloading.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Standard if/else syntax, conditionals are expressions.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Supports range loops and enhanced for loops.

while_loop.title: While Loop

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Uses def keyword for method definition.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are less common than Lists in Xtend.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Uses map literals with -> for entries.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Exceptions are unchecked by default in Xtend.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Xtend provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Xtend supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Xtend provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Xtend converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Xtend represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Xtend formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Xtend branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Xtend defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Xtend iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Xtend organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Xtend stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Xtend groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Xtend tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Xtend organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
